query: Which experimental design and metrics best quantify confirmation bias from pseudo-labeling, and which anti-confirmation methods (co-teaching, dual-teacher, label sharpening) reduce error propagation?

response.query: Which experimental design and metrics best quantify confirmation bias from pseudo-labeling, and which anti-confirmation methods (co-teaching, dual-teacher, label sharpening) reduce error propagation?
response.answer: Co-teaching and dual-teacher methods reduce error propagation from pseudo-labeling, while metrics like label accuracy and error rate quantify confirmation bias. Label sharpening also helps mitigate bias.
